consequence.statement: This is a new capability. Nothing breaks if the operator does nothing.

original.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for verifying image signatures in the sigstore bundle format, using verification type `SigstoreBundle`.

decision.reason: [ev-dc7503345583] describes only new support: signatures in the sigstore bundle format can now be verified using verification type `SigstoreBundle`. It doesn't say that anything existing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating. So if the operator does nothing, nothing changes for them, and "none" (informational, low) is the right consequence. The Service appProtocol diffs [ev-ea3f83a6e087][ev-bcf9822c2eb4] are separate changes and don't affect this feature's consequence.
